faqs.question: Is Costa Rica or Hawaii cheaper for a vacation?
faqs.answer: Costa Rica is significantly cheaper overall. A mid-range daily budget runs $100-150 per person versus $200-350 in Hawaii. Food is roughly half the price. Accommodation averages $90-180/night in Costa Rica versus $200-400/night in Hawaii.

faqs.question: Is Costa Rica or Hawaii better for families?
faqs.answer: Both are excellent. Hawaii is easier logistically (no passport, English everywhere). Costa Rica offers kids a genuine foreign-country experience with incredible wildlife encounters. Reddit parents say: Hawaii for relaxation, Costa Rica for adventure.

faqs.question: Do I need a passport to visit Costa Rica or Hawaii?
faqs.answer: US citizens need a valid passport for Costa Rica but not for Hawaii (a US state). Costa Rica allows 90-day visa-free stays. You also need proof of a return ticket.

faqs.question: When is the best time to visit Costa Rica vs Hawaii?
faqs.answer: Costa Rica dry season (December-April) has the best weather. Green season (May-November) brings afternoon showers but lower prices. Hawaii is pleasant year-round (75-85F). Best deals in spring and fall.

faqs.question: Which has better beaches, Costa Rica or Hawaii?
faqs.answer: Hawaii has more consistently beautiful, accessible beaches with better swimming conditions. Costa Rica beaches are wilder and more rustic but offer more variety across Pacific and Caribbean coasts.

faqs.question: Is Costa Rica safe for tourists?
faqs.answer: Costa Rica is generally very safe and considered one of the safest countries in Central America. Petty theft is the main concern. Tourist towns like La Fortuna, Manuel Antonio, and Tamarindo are very safe.

faqs.question: How long should I spend in Costa Rica vs Hawaii?
faqs.answer: Costa Rica: 10-14 days ideal (4 nights La Fortuna + 3 nights Monteverde + 4 nights Manuel Antonio). Hawaii: 7-10 days for one or two islands.
